verification.signature: Detached Ed25519 over the JCS (RFC 8785) canonical bytes of the document with the `proof` object removed; proof.signatureValue is base64url.
verification.timestamp: proof.timestamp.timestampToken is an RFC 3161 TimeStampResp (base64url) for the SHA-256 of the same canonical bytes; verify with: openssl ts -verify -data <canonical.bin> -in <token.der> -CAfile <tsa-ca.pem>
